text: FIX `graphQLSchemaFromRxSchema()` threw a plain error of the `get-graphql-from-jsonschema` dependency (or a `TypeError`) when the schema contains an object without `properties`, an array without `items`, a field without `type`, or a `type` list like `['string', 'null']`. A `type` list with `null` now creates a nullable GraphQL field. All other fields without a GraphQL type now throw the RxError `GQL5` that names the collection and the field path.
